title: Editor capture saves must stay in the build tree
body: The untouched-wave capture fixture passed all 15 CTest entries, but its scripted save wrote VIXEN/BuiltAssets/documents/sample_tri_layer.edited.vxd and dirtied that tracked binary. I had to restore it with git restore before committing. Copy the fixture document into the build tree or direct the capture session's save path to a build-tree location so capture verification does not mutate source assets.

title: Serialize DZN GPU capture and raymarch CTest fixtures
body: The RenderGraph CTest run with --parallel 4 produced two DZN Vulkan device-loss failures in BodyInstanceRayMarch render tests and segfaults in both editor and HUD capture producers. All four tests passed when rerun in isolation, indicating concurrent DZN GPU fixtures destabilize one another. Mark GPU capture producers and raymarch fixtures RUN_SERIAL or otherwise serialize DZN access so the test graph expresses the shared-device constraint.
